objective: Verify that checkbox, radio, chips, toggle, and swatch filters each have type-appropriate controls and states.
preconditions: A test widget contains checkbox, radio, chips, toggle, and swatch filters.
Each type has enough options to test wrap, active, inactive, long label, and empty states.
Type-specific style controls have been implemented.
steps: Test radio clear/all behavior and selected indicator.
Test chips wrap, selected, active summary, and remove affordances.
Test toggle on/off labels, knob, track, and alignment.
Test swatch color/image visuals with and without text labels.
Test keyboard focus-visible for each type.
expected_result: Each option-based filter feels like its own component instead of a generic pill with different data.
pass_criteria: type-specific controls appear only for active types.
active and hover states are consistent but not visually identical across unrelated types.
long labels do not break layout.
swatches remain accessible when labels are visually hidden.
